title: PostgreSQL REINDEX CONCURRENTLY does not block DROP INDEX during index functions (CVE-2026-116336)
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL's REINDEX CONCURRENTLY operation allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database by exploiting an index expression that issues DROP INDEX. This affects multiple PostgreSQL versions prior to 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7.
